big_case.notes: A private employer's challenge to an unpublished Second Circuit summary order enforcing an NLRB bargaining order at one television station. The Loper Bright framing touches a live question about review of Board legal conclusions, but the vehicle was fact-bound, drew no amici and no response, and was denied at first conference without comment.
